citation.description: _paragraph_from_block joins consecutive non-structural lines with a space; text_to_adf groups lines by blank-line delimiters into single paragraph nodes.

criteria.criterion: A blank-line-delimited block of soft-wrapped prose renders in Jira as ONE paragraph, with the wrapped lines joined.

citation.description: _BLOCK_MARKER_RE matches list markers, headings, blockquotes, fenced code, table rows; _is_structural returns True for these and for in-fence lines; _paragraph_from_block inserts hardBreak between structural lines. Tests in test_adf_soft_wrap.py:96-121 cover blank-line separation, list items, headings, fenced code, numbered lists, and blockquotes.

criteria.criterion: Intentional structure is preserved: blank-line paragraph separation still produces separate paragraphs, and list items / headings stay on their own lines rather than being joined into a run-on.
